basis: Static analysis of the canonical export + disassembly + raw ROM bytes (SHA-256 a7cd953c2a87af12ee2814a95c958dc23959d352ef9c5e7f82b8ab8952f264f1), plus SH-2E emulator dynamic checks of the three drive/request functions (tests/test_fuel_pump_control_dynamic.py); every pool, instruction word and ROM threshold cited here is re-read by utilities/scripts/rx8-pcm-pipeline/verify_fuel_pump_chain.py (docs/investigations/60E15120_N3J1E/reviews/fuel_pump_control/rawbin_reverify_log.txt). Harness-side identity of pkg pins to connector terminals remains board-level unresolved (docs/architecture/hardware/README.md evidence levels); terminals 5P/5L/4M/5A/4C/5AA from mazda-rx-8-pcm-pinout-series-1.md are candidate associations.
source: reference ROM 60E15120_N3J1E (submodules/Mazda_RX8_PCM_ReverseEngineering/Stock_ROMs/60E15120_N3J1E.bin); SH7055F pkg pins from docs/references/Sh7055h.pdf Table 1.3 (pins 7=PE0, 8=PE1, 9=PE2, 183=PJ7, 256=PD7)

0002f890.evidence: Writes PEDR_W 0xfffff754 bit 0x4 (PE2, SH7055F pkg pin 9) = (DAT_ffffbdd8 == 1) via ref_setRegister_REG_BIT_VAL 0x4bbc under SR mask 0xe0. Raw-bin verified: pool 0x2f930=0xbdd8 (cell), 0x2f932=0xf754 (PEDR low half), 0x2f93c=0x4bbc (helper), mask mov #0x4 at 0x2f8b0, cmp/eq 0x1 at 0x2f8a2. Caller 0x2f948, itself reached from the start-up sequence FUN_0001102a (pool 0x11308, jsr at 0x11136). Harness candidate: fuel pump relay control 5P (with immobilizer) / 5L (without); chip-pin->terminal routing unresolved.

0002f8ce.evidence: Writes PEDR_W bit 0x4 (PE2, pkg pin 9) = (FUN_0005c204(DAT_ffffbdd8) == 1) [diag actuator-override gate] and bit 0x2 (PE1, pkg pin 8) = (DAT_ffffbdbc == 1). Raw-bin verified: jsr 0x5c204 (pool 0x2f944) with r4=pool 0x2f930=0xbdd8; mask mov #0x4 at 0x2f8ea; r13=pool 0x2f932=0xf754 (PEDR); then cell pool 0x2f934=0xbdbc, mask mov #0x2 at 0x2f912, helper pool 0x2f93e=0x4bbc. Caller 0x2f95c ref_getOBDFuelModificationRequest (fueling task 0x117ac). PE1 harness candidate: fuel pump speed control 4M.

0002f948.evidence: Calls 0x2fbf0 (DAT_ffffbdd8 = 1), 0x2fbf8 (DAT_ffffbddc = 0xffff), 0x2f890 (PE2 output) - pools 0x2f9a4/0x2f9a8/0x2f9ac. Called from FUN_0001102a (pool 0x11308, jsr at 0x11136), which is itself entered once from the init chain (pool 0x628c = 0x0001102a, jsr at 0x61e4): the prime is a start-up action, not a periodic pass.

0002fc00.evidence: Computes DAT_ffffbdd8 (drives PE2) = DAT_ffffaa68(key-on flag) && (DAT_ffffbdda < 0x1f || (DAT_ffffa42c(injectors_off)==1 && DAT_ffffbde0==1) || DAT_ffffbddc <= 0x3e). Raw-bin verified pools: 0x2fcd0=0xaa68, 0x2fcd2=0xa42c, 0x2fce0=0xffffbdda, 0x2fce4=0xffffbdde, 0x2fce8=0xffffbde0, 0x2fcd8=0xffffbddc, 0x2fcce=0xbdd8; thresholds ROM 0x7bc58=0x1f (cmp/hs, keep while < 0x1f) and 0x7bc5c=0x3e (cmp/hi, keep while <= 0x3e); increment helper pool 0x2fcdc=0x2460, saturation word 0x2474=0xffff. bdda counts up while key-on, bdde while injectors-off, bddc every call; bde0 is only cleared here (0x2fc50) and produced by 0x2fcac. Caller 0x2f95c (fueling task worker 0x117ac).

0002fbf8.evidence: 8-byte body: DAT_ffffbddc = 0xffff (mov.w r1,@r0 at 0x2fbfe), which puts the run-on grace counter past its 0x3e keep-alive window. Pools 0x2fcd4=0x0000ffff, 0x2fcd8=0xffffbddc. Called from 0x2f948.

0002f98c.evidence: SR-masked wrapper: 0x3920 with mask 0x10 (pool 0x2f9b0), then 0x2fcac (pool 0x2f9cc), then tail-jump to the SR restore 0x3934 (pool 0x2f9c8). Entered from 0x11b80 (pool 0x11d20, jmp at 0x11ba0).

0002fcac.evidence: Resets the run-on grace counter (mov.w r4,@r3 with r4=0, pool 0x2fcd8=0xffffbddc) and sets DAT_ffffbde0 = (DAT_ffffbdde > ROM[0x7bc5a]); the threshold is 0x0000 in this bin (pools 0x2fcf4=0x0007bc5a, 0x2fce4=0xffffbdde, 0x2fce8=0xffffbde0; cmp/hi r0,r2 at 0x2fcbc). Reached through 0x2f98c from 0x11b80.

ffffbdd8.evidence: Written by 0x2fc00: key_on 0xffffaa68 && (bdda < 0x1f || (injectors_off a42c && bde0) || bddc <= 0x3e); primed 1 by 0x2fbf0. Drives PE2 (pkg pin 9); harness candidate fuel pump relay control 5P/5L. Pool-anchored: 0x2fcce=0xbdd8, 0x2f930=0xbdd8.

ffffbdbc.evidence: Written by 0x2fb20 ref_fuelingAddOBDControlMode_ = diag-wrapped ((bdd5 && engine_stopped_latch 0xffffa41c==0) || (injectors_off 0xffffa42c==1 && key_on 0xffffaa68==1) || (ROM[0x775bd]==0 && 0xffffbdd4>0)); the gate 0x5c2e4 forces the request on diagnostic modes 5/7. bdd5 = 1 when bdc0 >= bdc4, 0 when bdc0 < bdc4-3.5, else latched. Read by 0x2f8ce (PE1, pkg pin 8; harness candidate fuel pump speed control 4M), 0x2aa46 and 0x49308. Pool-anchored: 0x2fbca=0xbdbc, 0x2f934=0xbdbc.

ffffbdd5.evidence: Hysteresis latch inside 0x2fb20: set 1 at 0x2fb44 when DAT_ffffbdc0 >= DAT_ffffbdc4, cleared at 0x2fb4c once DAT_ffffbdc0 < DAT_ffffbdc4 - 3.5 (ROM 0x775d8), unchanged inside the band. Pool 0x2fbdc=0xffffbdd5.

ffffbdd4.evidence: Hold counter in 0x2fb20: loaded from ROM[0x775be]=0x01 while injectors_off 0xffffa42c==1, else incremented by 255 with u8 saturation (add r3,r4 at 0x2fbba, pool 0x2fbcc=0x00ff). Feeds the third request term (gated by ROM[0x775bd], which is 0x01 here so the term is inert). Pool 0x2fbe4=0xffffbdd4.

ffffbdc0.evidence: Filtered fuel-volume demand from 0x2f9d0 ref_filterFuelVolumeRequest = first_order_filter(rpm 0xffffb548 x fuel_volume_final 0xffffbeb0 x 0.12, coeff 0.75) via helper 0x23b0; also read back as the filter state by 0x2f9d0. Pools 0x2fae0=0xffffbdc0, 0x2fad4=0x3df5c28f (0.12), ROM 0x775c0=0.75. Compared against 0xffffbdc4 by 0x2fb20.

ffffbdc4.evidence: Max fueling request from 0x2f9fc ref_calculateFuelingRequestMaxForOBDControl: 2D-167 (0x6a97c) or 2D-168 (0x6a990) looked up on battery voltage 0xffffb590 while intake air 0xffffaddc stays within the 200/190 margins of 2D-166 (0x6a968, axis baro 0xffffad14), else 0.0 with 0xffffbdcc=1. Pool 0x2fafc=0xffffbdc4; reader 0x2fb20 (pool 0x2fbd0).

ffffbdc8.evidence: Margin subtracted from the 200/190 x 2D-166 product inside 0x2f9fc, then zeroed at the end of the function through the first branch of ROM byte 0x775bc (=0x00 here). Pool 0x2fb04=0xffffbdc8.

ffffbdd0.evidence: Result of the barometric-pressure lookup 2D-166 (descriptor 0x6a968, axis 0xffffad14) in 0x2f9fc; scaled by 200.0 (ROM 0x775c4) and 190.0 (0x775c8) to form the intake-air margins. Pool 0x2fae8=0xffffbdd0.

ffffbdcc.evidence: Set 1 by 0x2f9fc when intake air exceeds the 200 x reference margin (max demand forced to 0.0), cleared 0 on the lookup path. Pool 0x2fb00=0xffffbdcc.

ffffbdda.evidence: Key-on grace counter in 0x2fc00: sat16 increment while key_on 0xffffaa68==1 via helper 0x2460, reset to 0 otherwise; the request survives while it is < ROM[0x7bc58]=0x1f (cmp/hs at 0x2fc64). Pool 0x2fce0=0xffffbdda.

ffffbddc.evidence: Free-running run-on grace counter: sat16 increment on every 0x2fc00 call, kept <= ROM[0x7bc5c]=0x3e (cmp/hi at 0x2fc84); reset to 0 by 0x2fcac and loaded with 0xffff by 0x2fbf8, which disables the term. Pool 0x2fcd8=0xffffbddc.

ffffbdde.evidence: Injectors-off (fuel-cut) counter: sat16 increment while injectors_off 0xffffa42c==1, reset to 0 otherwise. Read by 0x2fcac, which compares it against ROM[0x7bc5a]=0x0000. Pool 0x2fce4=0xffffbdde.

ffffbde0.evidence: Injectors-off seen flag: cleared by 0x2fc00 when injection is enabled (0x2fc50) and set by 0x2fcac as (DAT_ffffbdde > ROM[0x7bc5a] = 0); it makes the second grace term hold while fuel is cut. Pool 0x2fce8=0xffffbde0.
